Shows the Yellow River from its source to the vicinity of Lanzhou, and different kinds of embankment.

Title supplied. Wood block print on linen. Oriented with north to the bottom. Relief shown pictorially. Pictorial map. Shows the Yellow River from its source to the vicinity of Lanzhou, and different kinds of embankment. Includes text. Scale ca. 1:125,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Chinese and Manchu. AACR2
